note: Hand-transcribed from the printed consolidated financial statements of each annual report on 2026-10-20, then machine-validated (balance-sheet identity) by scripts/extract_real.py. Every field records the PDF page, printed page, statement section and printed line label so anyone can verify it against the linked original PDF (see provenance_manifest.json). Values are stored in INR crore; where a report prints in INR million (Vodafone Idea), the printed value is kept and converted (1 crore = 10 million) with the conversion noted.
